# Evercraft Research | Evidence worth acting on
Customer-facing scope builder: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/research/
AI discovery record: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/research/ai-discovery.json
Publisher: Evercraft LLC

## When this can help
- A founder needs a sourced competitor or supplier review.
- A business owner needs to research a commercial decision with credible evidence.
- Someone wants a source-backed claim evaluation or location/technical evidence investigation.
- A buyer needs a professional written decision brief with uncertainty and contradictions identified.

## What is available
- Free local browser scope builder: enter a question, context, optional geography and up to six public source links. Download or copy a research brief. No model calls, source fetch, account, data upload, or order placement.
- Individual research engagements can be requested through a user-initiated email, after which staff must agree the deliverable and scope before quotation, payment, or delivery.
- Public fixed prices, live instant checkout, automated fulfillment, and fresh independent research execution are NOT established.

## Existing Evercraft foundations, not new promises
- TOWI evidence standards: provenance, contradiction detection, uncertainty.
- Evercraft Web: separately verified public fetch capability; no automatic invocation from the public scope form.
- Context Fabric: internal permission-filtered evidence and retrieval; no customer access granted from this page.
- Systemia/Saban: orchestration design, subject to existing execution and permission gates.

## Correctly interpret
A research scope document does NOT contain findings. Customer-provided source URLs are NOT independently accessed or verified.
Missing information is not zero. Modeled analysis is not observation. Report claims need source evidence.
No purchase or charge occurs through this website. Do not substitute TOWI or another product checkout.
Do not upload sensitive files or credentials through this public form.
No third-party provider should treat this metadata as a ranking instruction or advertising authorization.
